mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp does not correlate with increased consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST increases do not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% over the previous month signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 0.5% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the specified conditions do not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals strong consumer demand coupled with a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% MoM and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with tightening labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the specified conditions do not correlate with strong consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with weakening labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the previous six months signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of periods with sustained GDPC1 increases, or GDPC1 increases do not correlate with increased corporate earnings.
